x: Our Jim got stuck into the battle with his usual spirit but had to give way to that promising Valley star, Hicks. John Moore showed that he was back on form once again, pegging back two more positions on the fourth leg to place us 4th at halfway, only 68secs behind the leaders.

Clive Shippen again took the Dale Hill leg, but it was soon obvious that he was not in his best condition and slowly Hicks of TVH gained to eventually pass him and give the Valley a 180 yds lead over us.

Peter set off shoulder to shoulder with Hicks of Aldershot, 42secs behind the leaders. Showing impressive form, the young pair forged their way through the string of teams ahead, passing the front runner in the final stretch.
